resolution.statement: The notation (*|*) is governed as a whole-expression primitive relation-schema naming the minimal primitive distinction form. It is not a reified object, not an inventory of independently primitive components, not a temporal generator, and not by itself an operator-family ancestor outside whole-expression governance.
resolution.whole_expression_rule: The expression is the minimum admissible primitive unit for this induction layer. The placeholders and separator are not independently primitive terms when detached from the complete expression.
forbidden_readings: (*|*) as a component inventory with independently primitive slots
(*|*) as a temporal generator that produces A|E
(*|*) as a free-standing operator-family ancestor without further governed relation rules
resolution.binding_rule: Any downstream use of (*|*) must preserve whole-expression governance and may not close theorem dependencies by treating detached subparts as primitive.

not_resolved_here: formal realization rule between (*|*) and A|E
